description: Ekibimiz, NASA ve iş birliği yapan küresel uzay ajanslarını sağladığı, açık kaynaklı verileri analiz ederek Dünya ve uzay bilimlerine yenilikçi çözümler getirmeyi amaçlayan bir topluluktur.
summary: We've created a story about equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. This story isn't just a written account; it also conveys the emotions felt during those events.
details: Our project tells a story about forgotten equipment on Mars and the Moon through research. Its benefits lie in making this information easier for those who want to learn about it.
